jsonIsValid.meaning: true iff the host JSON parser accepts the complete input text

jsonIsObject.meaning: true iff accepted JSON has a non-null, non-array object root

jsonIsArray.meaning: true iff accepted JSON has an array root

jsonHasStringField.meaning: true iff an object root has an own property with a string value

jsonHasBooleanField.meaning: true iff an object root has an own property with a boolean value

jsonHasSafeIntegerField.meaning: true iff an object root has an own property represented by a finite JavaScript safe integer

jsonCanonicalizeOr.meaning: host JSON parse/stringify normalization, returning the supplied fallback on parse/stringify failure

rationale: Product-v1 lacks a checked JSON value representation with decimal-number semantics.
The existing FFI safely admits first-order String/Bool host boundaries.
This package provides practical validation without pretending host JSON.parse is formally verified.
future: checked Json value inductive after number/String semantics are sufficient
verified parser/serializer or proved refinement to a trusted parser
typed schema decoding into ProofScript structures
